title: 2019-20 Panini Mosaic #250 Eric Paschall Golden State Warriors Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 2019-20 Panini Mosaic sports trading card featuring Eric Paschall, a rookie player from the Golden State Warriors. The card is part of the National Basketball Association (NBA) league and has a standard size. It is an original and licensed reprint with a Mosaic parallel/variety. The card number is 250 and it is unsigned. 

The card is a great addition to any basketball trading card collection and is perfect for fans of the Golden State Warriors. It is a must-have for any Eric Paschall fan and is a great way to commemorate his rookie season. Get your hands on this card today and add it to your collection!
